claims.text: The system can generate natural language descriptions from annotated ontologies, translating a set of atoms representing answers to queries into sentences.
The system can create an intermediate representation from a paragraph of text, which can be used for purposes like cross-translation.
The system addresses the challenge of creating an abstract Wikipedia, showcasing its versatility in handling different ontologies.
